mechanism: Famotidine may inhibit gastric pH-dependent absorption of haloperidol and both drugs can cause CNS effects; haloperidol metabolism via CYP3A4/2D6 may be minimally affected by famotidine.
action: Monitor for reduced haloperidol efficacy or increased CNS adverse effects; consider separating administration times or using alternative antacid if haloperidol levels appear subtherapeutic.
